preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case integer N is in the range [1, 1000].
The number of test cases T matches the number of input lines minus the first line.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(num) <= 1000 for num in output_line.split()) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All integers in the output are positive and in the range [1, 1000].

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(num) == max(map(int, output_line.split())) for num in output_line.split()) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The maximum element in each output array is minimized (i.e., no smaller maximum exists for the given N).

postconditions.expression: all(not any(all(count % 2 == 0 for count in Counter(map(int, subarray)).values()) for subarray in [map(int, output_line.split())[i:j] for i in range(len(output_line.split())) for j in range(i + 1, len(output_line.split()) + 1)]) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: No subarray of the output array has all elements occurring with even frequency.
